SELECT 
    dp.recordregistry,
    dp.volgb,
    dp.datasense,
    sp.encstate,
    sp.aclstate,
    -- DSI calculation
    dp.volgb * CASE WHEN dp.datasense = 'High' THEN 3 
                    WHEN dp.datasense = 'Medium' THEN 2 
                    ELSE 1 END as DSI,
    -- SRS calculation
    CASE WHEN sp.encstate = 'Full' AND sp.aclstate = 'Strong' THEN 3
         WHEN sp.encstate = 'Full' OR sp.aclstate = 'Adequate' THEN 2
         ELSE 1 END as SRS
FROM dataprofile dp
JOIN securityprofile sp ON dp.profiletrace = sp.profilekey
WHERE dp.volgb * CASE WHEN dp.datasense = 'High' THEN 3 
                      WHEN dp.datasense = 'Medium' THEN 2 
                      ELSE 1 END > 100
  AND CASE WHEN sp.encstate = 'Full' AND sp.aclstate = 'Strong' THEN 3
           WHEN sp.encstate = 'Full' OR sp.aclstate = 'Adequate' THEN 2
           ELSE 1 END < 2;
